# Generated files, one glob per line.
#
# This file lives at .claude/generated-files.txt in your repository
# (/murmur:init copies it there from the plugin's example). The plugin's
# PreToolUse guard reads it and blocks any edit to a matching path, so a
# generated file can only change by being regenerated. The entries below are
# examples: replace them with your own generated files, or delete them all to
# switch the guard off.
#
# Format: <glob> <command that regenerates it>
# Everything up to the first space is the glob. The rest of the line is shown
# to the agent when the edit is blocked, so say exactly what to run.
# A glob that does not start with / or * matches any path ending that way,
# so repository-relative entries work whatever the checkout is named.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

PROMPTS.md  make prompts
